title: Tate's post-trip talk on solved energy

tellings.quote: I I saw while on this trip, we will never have to worry about energy. That's already been figured out.

plain: In 1948, after a trip to the American Southwest, a University of Minnesota physicist named John Torrance Tate is said to have told people, "I saw while on this trip, we will never have to worry about energy. That's already been figured out." Scott Ramsey, a researcher who studies a reported UFO crash, tells Michels this from Tate's archived records, and ties the trip to Vannevar Bush, who led US wartime science. Ramsey raises it because it would suggest Tate had seen some technology far beyond anything known.
